newsitem.title: USA: Intel price cuts less than expected - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Intel price cuts less than expected - WSJ.

text.p: Intel Corp's price cuts on its most powerful microprocessors were less than expected, the Wall Street Journal said Thursday.
The paper said Intel cut the price of a lower-end Pentium chip with a speed of 133 megahertz by 34 percent to $134 and reduced prices on midrange Pentiums with 166 megahertz by 27 percent to $295.
The report said Intel did not cut prices on most members of its high-end Pentium Pro family, and cut the price on a 166-megahertz Pentium with the new MMX technology by 13 percent to $356.
